note: The Trade restrictions of item_db_*.yml, for each item that sets one, with wAthena's names: no_drop, no_trade, trade_partner, no_sell, no_cart, no_storage, no_guild_storage, no_mail and no_auction. override is the group level that ignores them, 100 when it is missing, as ItemDatabase::parseBodyNode. itemdb_isrestricted also checks the cards of an item with slots, unless its first card is a special ID.
